-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Barrier Magic.png  |title= Barrier Magic |kanji= 結界魔法 |romaji= Kekkai Mahō |english= Barrier Magic (Netflix)  |user= #Jester Garandros #Lucius Zogratis }} :For the magic form, see Barrier Magic.  {{Nihongo|Barrier Magic|結界魔法|Kekkai Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and shape barriers.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to create and control barriers at will, which usually take the form of honeycomb-like walls made from smaller, tessellated hexagons. In order to use the magic to its full potential, s
    While regular magic barriers are typically in the shape of a dome or wall and anchored in place, the barriers deployed through this magic are more in flux and versatile, seeing as the user can freely resize, reshape, and
    Additionally, these barriers can be adjusted to interfere with Spatial Magic, making it difficult for an enemy to teleport in and out.{{Clr}}
